description: One comparable row per bank-year across every bank with a completed Q4 series, plus per-year cross-bank medians. Input for the cross-bank comparison views, quality scoring and historical benchmarking.
comparability_warning: Reporting basis is NOT uniform across this dataset and is carried on every row. Most banks are Solo/Standalone; SOUTHEASTB is Consolidated for its whole series; NBL is Solo including its Offshore Banking Unit; NRBCBANK changes from Consolidated to Solo at FY2020. Differences are small (0.1-0.5% of total assets where measurable) but a league table should surface the basis rather than hide it. Series lengths also differ: MIDLANDBNK starts at FY2013 and NRBCBANK at FY2013 because those banks did not exist earlier, and NRBCBANK ends at FY2024 because its FY2025 report is not yet available. Finally, reported RoA/RoE are computed on average balances by some banks and period-end by others, so roa_pct_period_end and roe_pct_period_end are recomputed here on a single convention and should be preferred for ranking. UPDATE 2026-08-26: extended CITYBANK, FIRSTSBANK, JAMUNABANK, MERCANBANK, MTB, UCB, GIB, ICBIBANK, NRBCBANK, PUBALIBANK to FY2025 (or as far as a report exists) and backfilled PUBALIBANK's FY2011-2014, closing the crisis-period comparability gap this warning previously flagged. FY2025 now covers 24 of 27 banks (was 16). The remaining 3 gaps (EXIMBANK, GIB, FIRSTSBANK) are no longer a research gap but a confirmed, permanent series-end: all three were declared non-viable/merged by Bangladesh Bank into the newly formed state-owned Sammilito Islami Bank PLC (with Union Bank and Social Islami Bank, neither yet in this dataset) as part of a resolution of S Alam Group-linked banks - their absence from FY2025 is itself a data point about the sector crisis, not missing research. PUBALIBANK's FY2025 is sourced from press coverage of AGM-approved results, not the primary annual report (Cloudflare-blocked site) - total_assets vs liabilities+equity carry an unreconciled 0.29% gap; see its sources.json and coverage matrix entry. UCB's FY2025 required OCR of a scanned audited-FS filing (real Annual Report PDF unreachable) but its balance sheet and P&L fully reconcile from the primary source. See per-bank sources.json files for full detail. UPDATE 2026-08-26 (part 2): added the 9 previously-not-started banks (NRBBANK, ONEBANKPLC, PREMIERBAN, RUPALIBANK, SBACBANK, SHAHJABANK, SIBL, STANDBANKL, UNIONBANK) - all 36 target banks now have at least a partial Q4 series. RUPALIBANK's FY2023 is a partial year (capital/asset-quality only, no balance sheet - sourced from Wayback Machine, an unusually sparse archive; FY2024/2025 confirmed unavailable). SIBL's series starts FY2010, one year before this file's usual FY2011 floor. STANDBANKL's FY2025 is not yet published (bank converted to Standard Islami Bank PLC, 10-Feb-2026) - a lag, not a permanent gap. UNIONBANK and SIBL are 2 of the 5 Sammilito-merger banks (with EXIMBANK, FIRSTSBANK, GIB already in this dataset) - see bank_financials/UNIONBANK/sources.json for the most severe case: a FY2023 profit later restated to a loss after Bangladesh Bank found manipulated data.

metric_notes.provision_coverage_pct: Provision held against classified loans, as % of classified loans. Uses the specific provision where a bank splits it, otherwise total loan-loss provision. Null where the bank publishes no provision figures at all (NBL, MIDLANDBNK early years).
metric_notes.unprovided_npl_x_equity: Classified loans minus provision held, divided by shareholders equity. The single most discriminating solvency measure in this dataset: it separates banks that recognised FY2024 losses from those that did not.
metric_notes.nim_proxy_pct: Net interest income over period-end gross loans. A proxy, not a reported NIM.
